title: Dragon SuperDraco abort triggers
body: If F9 second stage anomalies cause loss of thrust > 10 % below nominal during ascent, or if any of the propellant pressure sensors trip > 15 % off nominal, Dragon shall command launch escape via SuperDracos. Crew g-load limited to 4.5 g sustained.

title: Approach abort gate at 20 m KOZ
body: Dragon approach to ISS at 20 m: validate range-rate < 0.06 m/s, lateral offset < 0.4 m, attitude error < 1 deg. Any breach triggers automatic abort to 250 m hold; manual abort via crew COTS button always available.

title: RCS thruster failure during approach
body: If a doghouse RCS thruster fails during ISS approach, isolate the doghouse and re-plan with the remaining 3 doghouses. If 2 doghouses are degraded, abort to retrograde safe orbit and prepare for de-orbit.
citation: Starliner Anomaly Report (Boeing, 2024) – CFT mission report

title: Splashdown recovery weather constraints
body: Dragon splashdown requires < 6 ft significant wave height, surface winds < 10 kt sustained, lightning-free in 10 nm radius for 30 minutes prior to entry. Otherwise wave-off to next opportunity (typically +24 h).
